response.justification: The candidate lacks mandatory technical requirements essential to this role. While demonstrating 16 years of software engineering experience, they possess only ~6 months of recent C++ development (versus required 5–10 years), no Windows platform background, and zero capital markets or financial services domain expertise. Strong engineering fundamentals and communication skills cannot compensate for these critical gaps in a senior-level role requiring immediate contribution to capital markets systems.
strengths: Exceptional communication and mentoring demonstrated through conference talks, workshops, and course development
Strong software engineering practices foundation including TDD, CI/CD pipelines, GitLab infrastructure, and Docker
Proven ability to rapidly master diverse technology stacks and deliver production systems across web, mobile, and embedded domains
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments in 2014–2015) versus mandatory requirement of 5–10 years strong hands-on C++ development
Complete absence of capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or financial services domain knowledge required by the role
No documented Windows platform development experience despite explicit mandate; career focused on cross-platform, Linux, and cloud-based systems
